blocks.text: The Mystere incident was an EverQuest controversy revolving around a player named "Mystere", banned from the game by Verant over a controversial role-playing story.

Full Moon o Sagashite  is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Arina Tanemura. It was serialized in Shueisha's shōjo manga magazine Ribon from January 2002 to June 2004 and collected in seven tankōbon volumes.
Mystere was an Indonesian racehorse. In 1978, Mystere won the Indonesian Triple Crown, making him the first horse to achieve this title in the history of horse racing in Indonesia.
